Approve a proposal; --promote publishes it as a new version

Usage:
  kaab proposals approve PROPOSAL_ID [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help              help for approve
      --notes string      notes on the new version
      --promote           publish the change as a new version (alias latest moves)
      --remember string   none or site (a dismissal remembered for the hostname)

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
